verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for Meilisearch, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file, markdown docs and MCP server are related AI-facing features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
